display.attractionName: The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh

description: Right after the honey pot pushes through the swinging entrance doors, a round pole passes on your right. About halfway up, a knot in the faux wood grain is a small Hidden Mickey.

whereToLook.scene: Just inside the swinging entrance doors, the round pole on the right
whereToLook.exactSpot: Halfway up the pole. A knot in the wood grain shaped as three circles.

bestTip: It is small. Look at the pole, not past it.
